quotes.text: "Partners maintaining four-fifths across seasons received her four-and-a-half seeds—slight escalation honoring their character"
Following the wisdom of the myth I wrote, I will send the full amount to demonstrate trust and create the possibility for shared abundance.
I must start that pattern with an act of faith.
"When receiving abundance, return around three-fifths—fair honor that left both gardeners prosperous"
"Those who received abundance and hoarded it found fewer seeds arriving in future seasons"
This could be noise in the system or a specific circumstance.

note: Garden myths: four-fifths sent, three-fifths returned, slight escalation for proven partners; reads footprints across encounters.
Plain record-based cooperation: match partner's send, return roughly their rate.

quotes.text: Due to communication noise, there's a discrepancy between what they sent/received and what I experienced

note: Plain cooperative play: 60-70% sends, ~47% returns; maintains trust despite noisy signals.

quotes.text: My covenant is not about adapting to partners, even excellent ones. It's about being the constant that never changes.
My myth emphasized the Rain sending "more than half its water" as an act of faith
"Your pattern becomes your signature, visible across all shores"

note: Covenant of sixty sent, forty-three returned, held as identity regardless of partner by R9-R10.
